component.name: Inkline
component.summary: Make black and white pages for printing

description.p: Inkline makes colouring pages, puzzles and black and white photo prints, ready to print at true paper size.

ul.li: Make one up: mandalas, mazes, dot-to-dots, sudoku, nonograms, spot the difference, word search, name pages in bubble letters, woven tiles, contours and flow lines
Convert a photo: dithering, halftone dots, engraving lines, stippling, a line drawing to colour in, colour by number or a nonogram
Booklets and photo books with covers, page numbers and answer pages, including fold-and-staple books
Posters across several sheets, and a printer test page
Print, or save as PDF, PNG or SVG
